title: GenRubric: Self-Evolving Rubric Generation for Scalable LLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29856v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as scalable evaluators for open-ended tasks. However, many LLM judges derive query-specific criteria during scoring, leaving the evaluation requirements insufficiently specified and their coverage difficult to audit. Query-specific rubrics make these requirements explicit, but expert-written rubrics are costly to construct, while existing automatic methods typically rely on inference-time refinement or external supervision. We introduce GenRubric, a self-evolving framework that improves rubric generation from unlabeled queries without requiring additional human annotations during self-evolution. Our approach is based on rubric-induced self-consistency: independently sampled rubrics for the same query provide partial views of its latent evaluation requirements, and a comprehensive rubric should induce a response that generalizes across these complementary evaluation views. translated_title: GenRubric：面向可扩展大语言模型评估的自进化评分标准生成
translated_abstract: 大语言模型正越来越多地被用作开放式任务的可扩展评估器。然而，许多LLM评判者是在打分过程中才推导针对特定查询的评估标准，这导致评估需求未被充分明确地规定，其覆盖范围也难以审计。针对特定查询的评分标准可以使这些需求显式化，但由专家撰写的评分标准构建成本高昂，而现有的自动化方法通常依赖于推理时的迭代优化或外部监督。我们提出了GenRubric，这是一个自进化框架，能够从无标注查询中改进评分标准的生成，且在自进化过程中无需额外的人工标注。我们的方法基于“评分标准诱导的自洽性”：为同一查询独立采样的评分标准提供了其潜在评估需求的部分视图，而一个全面的评分标准应当能够诱导出在这些互补评估视图之间具备泛化性的响应。
tldr: 提出GenRubric，一个无需人工标注的自进化评分标准生成框架，通过评分标准诱导的自洽性从无标注查询中自动生成全面且可审计的评估标准，实现可扩展的LLM评估。
en_tdlr: GenRubric is a self-evolving rubric generation framework that automatically produces comprehensive evaluation rubrics from unlabeled queries via rubric-induced self-consistency, requiring no human annotations, thereby enabling scalable LLM evaluation.
